item_short_desc: Snap your Rothco Trucker Wallet to your belt loop for secure and quick access to your identification, credit cards, cash, and other vital documents.
description: Snap your Rothco Trucker Wallet to your belt loop for secure and quick access to your identification, credit cards, cash, and other vital documents. This compact wallet features 3 large open compartments and 1 zipper compartment with a smaller compartment inside for additional storage. The snap belt loop with chain will keep your wallet secured to you at all times.
